prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1415; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Officers were dispatched to a low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas, where Driver 1 and Driver 2 were involved in a collision between two passenger vehicles traveling in opposite directions. Driver 1 was the operator of the first vehicle and is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and stated that the front of the vehicle struck Driver 2's vehicle. The reported knee injury is consistent with the type and force of the impact observed at the scene. Officers examined the damage to both vehicles, which corresponds with the described collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several details of the account, though no independent witnesses were identified. Officers confirmed through the scene and statements from others present that Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision. Based on available records and inspection, no prior damage to the vehicle was found. Further follow-up is pending.
